description: Voirie concernée par des travaux d'assainissement et d'eau potable sur la Communauté de Communes Coeur Côte Fleurie is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by data.coeurcotefleurie.org. Road sections that have been the subject, since September 1, 2014, of sanitation and drinking water works on Community of Communes Coeur Côte fleurie. For each section, the name of the road, the date of commencement of the works and their duration shall be specified. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Road concerned by sanitation and drinking water works on the Community of Communes Coeur Côte Fleurie" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
